ShortDescription.Value: A soft, adjustable light that follows your cursor, day and night, so you can see into dark corners and building shadows.

Publish.LongDescription:
**Better Cursor Light** puts a soft light wherever your mouse points, so you can see what you are building at night and in the deep shadows of buildings during the day.
**Features** - Works day and night. Brightness is balanced automatically, so one intensity setting looks right in both. - Light distance: move the light further from the cursor for a softer, wider, less concentrated glow. - Warm tone: tint the light with a real color temperature (1500 K candle to 6500 K daylight). - Full RGB color on a 0-255 scale. - Optional light reflections: turn off the shiny highlights on roads, water and glass for a matte look. - Intensity can go below 1 for a subtle light. - English, Chinese (Simplified) and German settings text.
**Settings**: Options > Better Cursor Light. Use "Reset settings" to restore the defaults.
**Credits**: Based on Mouse Light by Dnikolas991, which was itself inspired by the Cities: Skylines 1 mod EYM.
Publish.ChangeLog: First release of Better Cursor Light: daytime lighting, light distance, warm tone, 0-255 colors, optional reflections and a wider intensity range.
